title: Twisted Wares "Let's Get Baked" Funny Oven Mitt
writeup: The Twisted Wares "Let's Get Baked" oven mitt (model 420603, UPC 815415026947) is $6.99 new at Woot. What The Soap and So Slanty both sell the exact same mitt for $14.99, so this is more than half off. It is cotton canvas with thick batting and a hanging loop. Only 3 were left when we checked, limit 3 per order.
